● Home is stocked with Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottles of water, and a starter amenity package with a roll of paper towels, dish soap, sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher soap, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and a roll of toilet paper in each bathroom.

Rental ready by Feburary 14th, professionally decorated, brand new home!

Welcome to your ultimate beach escape, where timeless coastal charm meets modern luxuries. This stunning new construction luxury vacation rental home is designed to bring people together while offering luxurious spaces to relax and recharge. With six bedrooms, including two primary king suites—one on the 2nd floor and one on the 3rd floor—this home is perfect for families or groups who want the ultimate privacy and comfort. There are also five full and two half bathrooms, ensuring plenty of space for everyone.

The heart of the home is the chef's kitchen, a culinary haven outfitted with premium appliances, a spacious island, and everything you need to prepare meals as unforgettable as the sunsets. The adjacent wet bar elevates entertaining, making it easy to craft your favorite cocktails or pour a crisp glass of wine. Thoughtfully curated coastal décor adds warmth and a breezy sophistication to every corner, making you feel right at home when you arrive.

The home also features four additional beautifully designed bedrooms, offering ample space for family and friends to gather, relax, and enjoy the comfort and luxury of the coastal lifestyle. Whether enjoying a peaceful night's rest or waking up to the sound of the waves, these rooms provide the perfect place to recharge for your next adventure.

Step outside to discover your private oasis, a sparkling private pool surrounded by lounge seating and a serene backdrop. Perfect for morning coffee or evening swims under the stars, this space defines relaxation. Four included bikes make exploring the area a breeze, whether cruising along 30A to discover nearby communities or biking to the sugar-white sands for a fun-filled day at the beach.

The second and third floors offer breathtaking Gulf views, reminding you how close you are to the turquoise waters and sugar-white sands. Located just a steps from the public Phillips Inlet Beach Access, your toes will be in the sand in minutes. Plus, you're a short bike ride to the chic boutiques and dining of 30Avenue, the charming streets of Rosemary Beach, and the architectural beauty of Alys Beach.

Whether lounging poolside, dining al fresco on the balcony, or exploring all the 30A lifestyle has to offer, this home is your gateway to an unforgettable coastal experience. Don't wait to make this luxurious retreat yours—book your stay today and start living the beach vacation you've always dreamed of!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
